findings.reason: the section must name `FACET_QUESTION_FIELDS` and `_content_top_levels` as the owner to extend, or the implementer reads answers through the wrong key list.
findings.text: §26 says "The Python side is the facet-aware form of the existing `triage_relevance`, sharing `SCORE_DIMENSION_NAMES`", but `triage_relevance` (imas_codex/discovery/code/scorer.py:228) reads `answers[name]["noul"]` over `SCOPE_NOULS`, and the content-arm facet answers carry a `score` key with no `noul` (verified in the prototype's own `/home/ITER/mcintos/.cache/imas-codex-jev/jev_score_results.json`: `data_access_depth` = `{type, score, probabilities, confidence}`) — so a Python facet-relevance built on that form over `SCORE_DIMENSION_NAMES` reads a key that does not exist, and the value it needs is `score / top_level` taken through `FACET_QUESTION_FIELDS` (:113) and `_content_top_levels` (:233), which is exactly how `_relevance_item` (:286-290) already does it; `score_worker` calls the mirror at imas_codex/discovery/code/workers.py:574 to decide descriptions, so the defect lands on a live path

findings.reason: the section must state the fragment is parameterised by its owner or drop the chunk-level exclusion, since as written its two bullets cannot both hold.
findings.text: §27 requires the node to "exclude ... any chunk embedded in the last two hours" while also claiming it "renders the existing `_CODE_CHUNK_CASCADE` ... it never spells the traversal a third time", but that fragment (imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py:402) fixes its traversal as `(n)<-[:FROM_FILE]-(ce:CodeExample)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(cc:CodeChunk)` and offers no hook for a per-chunk predicate, so a two-hour filter on `cc.embedded_at` cannot be applied to the rendered text — the node must either spell a modified copy (the third spelling the section forbids) or the owner must gain an optional chunk predicate, which the section does not say

findings.reason: the section must account for the added surface in its own text — what it retires or merges, or why nothing can be — as the rubric requires of any section that adds to these families.
findings.text: §26 adds a new discovery setting `code-facet-admission-threshold` in `[tool.imas-codex.discovery]` with a new accessor in `imas_codex/settings.py` (beside `get_code_ingest_threshold`, :1051) and a new `content` entry in `CODE_RESET_SPECS` (imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py:408), which `reset_to_option` (imas_codex/cli/discover/common.py:78-91) turns into a new accepted value of the `--reset-to` Choice — three additions to the public surface, and not the sizes the supplied budget recorded: public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; the section names nothing it retires or merges

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §26 extends existing owners (`relevance_predicate`, `CODE_RESET_SPECS`, `settings.py`) rather than adding a module, and §27 reuses the shared cascade, so neither adds surface without hiding behaviour.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — the facet clause is placed in `relevance_predicate` (scorer.py:91), the one content-gate owner, and §27 reuses `_CODE_CHUNK_CASCADE` (reset.py:402) rather than forking it.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §26 adds a new setting (`code-facet-admission-threshold`), a new `settings.py` accessor and a new `CODE_RESET_SPECS` target (which widens the `--reset-to` Choice) without naming what it retires or merges, or why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §26's Python mirror names `triage_relevance`/`SCORE_DIMENSION_NAMES` as the machinery to extend, but the owner that already reads a facet answer is `FACET_QUESTION_FIELDS` (imas_codex/discovery/code/scorer.py:113) with `_content_top_levels` (:233); `triage_relevance` (:228) reads a `noul` key the facet answers do not carry.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — §27's chunk-level two-hour exclusion cannot ride on the shared `_CODE_CHUNK_CASCADE` verbatim, so it needs the owner extended rather than rendered as claimed.
